Sam (sales): looping eng-sec + procurement — TeleHub wants to kick off a POC with us. They sent a SIG/CAIQ but unclear what their data processing scope is. need a quick read-thru before we move to contract :eyes:
Jess (eng-security): thanks — can you paste the CAIQ link and highlight the parts about data flow and subprocessors? we'll need envs, retention, and encryption details.
Sam (sales): https://telehub.example.com/caiq.pdf — vendor said 'only aggregated telemetry' in the pitch, but sales asked for confirmation in writing.
TeleHub Support: hi all — TeleHub here. For the POC we will collect SDK telemetry (events, session metrics). No customer raw content will be stored. We can provide a scoped DPA and SOC2 report. Our CAIQ: https://telehub.example.com/caiq.pdf.
Mike (procurement): quick q — who are your subprocessors? any third-party analytics processors? need a list for our intake form.
TeleHub Support: subprocessors: AWS (us-west-2), Segment (for optional routing), Datadog (ops monitoring). for POC you can opt-out of Segment.
Jess (eng-security): please confirm encryption at rest + in transit, and whether KMS is customer-keyable. Also where the SDK uploads are processed (edge vs central).
TeleHub Support: TLS1.2+ for in-transit, AES-256 at rest. We support customer-managed KMS keys for Dedicated/Enterprise plans; not for free POC tenants. Processing happens in our us-west-2 ingestion cluster (no cross-region replication for POC).
Olivia (devex): important — does the SDK collect any PII by default? need to know if we have to sanitize on our side for the POC.
TeleHub Support: default SDK collects device_id, session_id, event_name. SDK has config to disable/strip fields. example config to disable email collection:
```
telehub.init({
  collectUserEmail: false,
  maskIP: true
})
```
Jess (eng-security): good. please provide a data flow diagram (simple PNG) showing ingestion -> processing -> retention. also retention defaults and delete API timeline.
TeleHub Support: attaching mock flow (link): https://telehub.example.com/flows/poc-flow.png. retention defaults: 90 days; delete API is async within 7 days for POC.
Sam (sales): thanks — procurement, can we accept subprocessors list for POC if TeleHub agrees to DPA + data isolation note?
Mike (procurement): ok provisionally. need TeleHub to sign DPA and share SOC2 Type II report and the subprocessor addendum. will approve POC after those are in tle intake doc.
Jess (eng-security): one blocker: we require CSP/CAIQ answers for sections 3.2 (data export) and 5.1 (key mgmt) to be explicit. TeleHub, can you mark those in the CAIQ or provide short answers we can attach to the ticket?
TeleHub Support: will do — we'll annotate CAIQ questions 3.2 and 5.1 by EOD PT and upload SOC2.
Infra-bot: deploy-notice: security-docs-uploader v0.3 run completed for ticket #5234 (artifact: caiq-annotated-180934).
Jess (eng-security): great, once we get annotated CAIQ + SOC2 + DPA, eng-sec will do a final pass (should be quick).
Sam (sales): sweet — moving to prep contract checklist. :thumbsup:
